title: U.S. Senate passes sweeping AI regulation bill with bipartisan support
summary: The Senate voted 68-31 to advance landmark legislation that would require federal oversight of large AI systems, marking the most significant tech regulation in decades.

title: Federal Reserve signals pause in rate hikes as inflation cools to 2.1%
summary: Chair Powell indicated that the central bank is comfortable holding rates steady through summer, citing sustained progress on inflation without meaningful labor market deterioration.

title: Leaked Pentagon files reveal undisclosed drone program in three countries
summary: Documents obtained by The Intercept show covert drone surveillance operations conducted without congressional notification in Somalia, Pakistan, and Yemen since 2024.

title: Investigative report: Private prison contractors received $4.2bn in no-bid COVID contracts
summary: A two-year investigation found that federal agencies bypassed competitive bidding requirements to award billions to companies with documented safety violations.

title: Global arms exports hit record $142 billion amid continued conflicts
summary: SIPRI data shows weapons exports grew 18% year-on-year, with the U.S. accounting for 43% of global transfers and European deliveries up sharply due to the ongoing conflict in Ukraine.

title: Argentina logra acuerdo con FMI por USD 20.000 millones para estabilizar el peso
summary: El gobierno de Milei anunció un nuevo programa de financiamiento con el Fondo Monetario Internacional, que incluye metas fiscales estrictas y una banda cambiaria ampliada.

title: Brazil's deforestation drops 45% as enforcement drones deployed across Amazon
summary: INPE satellite data confirms the sharpest annual decline in Amazon deforestation since monitoring began, attributed to increased enforcement operations and international funding.

title: Venezuela holds emergency summit with Caribbean allies over U.S. sanctions
summary: President Maduro convened regional leaders in Caracas to coordinate a response to the renewed sanctions package, which targets the country's oil sector and financial institutions.

title: El Salvador: Three journalists detained covering anti-gang crackdown released after 40 days
summary: Reporters from two independent outlets were held without charges under the state of emergency law, drawing international condemnation from press freedom organizations.

title: Mexican cartel expands cocaine processing operations into Ecuador, report finds
summary: An 18-month investigation documents how Sinaloa Cartel affiliates have established at least seven processing labs in Ecuador's coastal provinces, exploiting governance gaps.

title: Russia announces new Arctic military base construction ahead of NATO summit
summary: The Defense Ministry confirmed construction of a new dual-use military and scientific station on Novaya Zemlya, equipped with next-generation radar systems and extended winter operations capacity.

title: Путин подписал указ о расширении программы «Семейный капитал»
summary: Новый указ увеличивает размер выплат для семей с тремя и более детьми, а также расширяет перечень целей использования средств материнского капитала.

title: Russian economy grows 3.4% but Western analysts warn of sustainability risks
summary: Rosstat data shows continued growth driven by defense spending, but independent economists warn that military Keynesianism has structural limits and inflation is underreported.

title: How Russia's shadow fleet bypasses oil sanctions: an investigation
summary: Meduza tracked over 200 tankers operating under obscure flags of convenience, documenting a network of shell companies in UAE, Turkey, and India that routes Russian crude to Asian markets.

title: Moscow court sentences opposition figure to 9 years in closed-door proceedings
summary: The verdict against former regional governor on treason charges was handed down without public access to the courtroom, drawing condemnation from human rights groups.

title: China launches world's largest offshore wind farm off Fujian coast
summary: The 8.5 GW Fuqing Offshore Wind Complex, stretching across 420 square kilometers, begins commercial operations, representing a milestone in China's goal of 1,200 GW renewable capacity by 2030.

title: Taiwan provocations will be met with decisive force, PLA warns after drill
summary: A People's Liberation Army spokesperson issued a stern warning following joint U.S.-Taiwan naval exercises, calling the maneuvers a 'dangerous provocation' and announcing new air incursion response protocols.

title: Hong Kong sees wave of foreign business exits as new security provisions take effect
summary: At least 14 multinational companies have formally restructured their Asia-Pacific headquarters away from Hong Kong in the past quarter, citing legal uncertainties under the expanded national security framework.

title: Inside China's social credit blacklist: 12 million citizens barred from travel
summary: Court documents and provincial government data compiled by CDT reveal the full scale of travel and financial restrictions applied to citizens flagged by the expanded scoring system.

title: Chinese banks face $340bn in hidden local government debt, analysis shows
summary: An investigation into off-balance-sheet financing vehicles used by local authorities reveals systemic exposure that exceeds official figures, raising concerns among international creditors.

title: India and Pakistan agree to resume trade through Wagah crossing after 3-year halt
summary: The breakthrough agreement, brokered with UAE mediation, will initially allow pharmaceutical and agricultural goods and is seen as a significant de-escalation following the 2023 border standoff.

title: India's Supreme Court rules caste-based affirmative action in private sector is constitutional
summary: A five-judge constitutional bench upheld a Maharashtra law mandating 13% reservation for Scheduled Castes in private companies with over 100 employees, splitting the court 3-2 on reasoning.

title: Electoral bonds data reveals ₹8,200 crore flowed to ruling party from companies under CBI investigation
summary: Analysis of ECI disclosure data shows a statistically significant correlation between Central Bureau of Investigation raids on companies and subsequent large electoral bond purchases.

title: Manipur: 18 months of ethnic conflict and a government that looked away
summary: A long-form investigation documents how central and state authorities failed to prevent the displacement of over 70,000 people and the destruction of 6,000 homes in the ongoing ethnic conflict.

title: Adani Group's port concession contracts contain secret revenue-sharing clauses, documents show
summary: Concession agreements obtained through RTI requests reveal terms that differ significantly from those disclosed in public filings, raising questions about competitive bidding processes at seven major ports.
